title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC24 > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity (w/dither) > FLAC16 via xACT)

ai_review.summary: A superb Hunter Seamons matrix captures a high‑energy early‑Brent show with standout jams on Cassidy, Tennessee Jed and China/Rider.
ai_review.review: The matrix recording is praised as crisp, balanced and often described as “stellar,” with only minor comments about a slightly boomy low end that the engineer smooths out. The performance itself is highlighted for its fire‑cracker energy – especially the jam‑heavy Cassidy, tight Tennessee Jed, soaring Sugaree and a monster China/Rider leading into an inspired Playing in the Band on the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are overwhelmingly positive (six 5‑star, one 4‑star), consistently praising both the matrix sound quality and the musical performance, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with excellent balance; some reviewers note a slightly boomy/thick low end that Seamons mitigates with added thinness, but overall the soundboard‑plus‑audience blend is described as outstanding.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set with tight jams; second set builds nicely, highlighted by a stellar China/Rider segue into an inspired Playing in the Band.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice a little ragged but overall powerful singing and guitar work; praised as inspired.
band_member_comments.Phil: Usually buried in mixes from this year, but clearly audible here – especially on the Minglewood jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards are highlighted as inspired; early Brent era noted as a high point.
